title: Siman 278
section: The Greatness and Awesomeness of His Attainments

segments.he: (לח) אמר שפעל אצל השם יתברך שכשבאין לפניו להתפלל על מקשה לילד, שלא יהיה לה הקשוי לילד כי אם עד אותה השעה שבאין לפניו, ותכף שבאין לפניו תלד מיד:
segments.en: (38.) He said that he accomplished before Hashem Yisburach that when they come before him to pray on behalf of a woman having difficulty in labor — that she should not have the difficulty of labor except until that very hour when they come before him. And immediately when they come before him she should give birth at once.
